ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 38 of 76 
 
 
 
“For we are God’s masterpiece. He has created us anew in Christ  
Jesus, so we can do the good things he planned for us long ago.’” (Ephesians 2:10, NLT) 
 
Why involve God in the decisions we make? 
 
• God promises to guide us. 
– (Psalm 32:8) 
– (John 10:3–4, 27) 
 
• God has a good plan for our lives. 
– (Jeremiah 29:11) 
– (Romans 12:2) 
– (John 10:10, 15) 
 
How does God guide us? 
 
 
1. COMMANDING SCRIPTURE  
 
• General will  
– General instruction for marriage, work, money, children, elderly relatives (2 Timothy 
3:16; Psalm 119:105, 130–133) 
 
• Primary calling 
– To love God 
– To love others 
– To become like Jesus
